6	
7	## Registry Validation
8	
9	```bash
10	uip maestro flow registry get core.logic.loop --output json
11	```
12	
13	Confirm: input ports `input` and `loopBack`, output ports `success` and `output`, required input `collection`. Set the node instance `typeVersion` to the `version` field from this response — do not hardcode it.
14	
15	## JSON Structure
16	
17	### Loop node
18	
19	```json
20	{
21	  "id": "loop1",
22	  "type": "core.logic.loop",
23	  "typeVersion": "<DEFINITION_VERSION>",
24	  "display": { "label": "Loop over items" },
25	  "inputs": {
26	    "collection": "=js:$vars.fetchData.output.body.items",
27	    "parallel": false
28	  }
29	}
30	```
31	
32	Set `"parallel": true` to execute all iterations concurrently.
33	
34	### Loop body nodes — `parentId` required
35	
36	Every node inside the loop body **must** have `"parentId"` set to the loop node's ID. Without this, the runtime does not know the node is part of the loop and variableUpdates will not fire per-iteration.
37	
38	```json
39	{
40	  "id": "processItem",
41	  "type": "core.action.script",
42	  "typeVersion": "1.0",
43	  "display": { "label": "Process item" },
44	  "inputs": {
45	    "script": "return $vars.product * $vars.loop1.currentItem"
46	  },
47	  "parentId": "loop1"
48	}
49	```
50	
51	> **Critical:** If you omit `parentId`, the node executes outside the loop context. State variables will not update across iterations and loop outputs like `currentItem` will be inaccessible.
52	
53	## Adding / Editing
54	
55	For step-by-step add, delete, and wiring procedures, see [editing-operations.md](../../editing-operations.md). Use the JSON structure above for the node-specific `inputs` and `parentId`.
56	
57	## Wiring
58	
59	Loop nodes have a specific wiring pattern:
60	
61	- `input` — entry from upstream
62	- `output` — into the loop body (first body node)
63	- `loopBack` — return from last body node back to loop
64	- `success` — exit after loop completes (to next downstream node)
65	
66	See [editing-operations.md](../../editing-operations.md) for edge add procedures.
67	
68	## Accessing Loop Variables Inside Body
69	
70	Inside the loop body, access the current item via `$vars.<loopId>.currentItem`:
71	
72	```javascript
73	// In a Script node inside the loop body (parentId must be set to the loop node)
74	const item = $vars.loop1.currentItem;
75	const index = $vars.loop1.currentIndex;
76	return { processed: item.name.toUpperCase(), position: index };
77	```
78	
79	| Variable | Description |
80	| --- | --- |
81	| `$vars.<loopId>.currentItem` | The item being processed in this iteration |
82	| `$vars.<loopId>.currentIndex` | 0-based iteration index |
83	| `$vars.<loopId>.collection` | The full collection being iterated |
84	
85	> **Do not use `iterator.currentItem`.** The correct access pattern is `$vars.<loopId>.currentItem` where `<loopId>` is the loop node's `id` (e.g., `$vars.loop1.currentItem`).
86	
87	### Required node variables for loop outputs
88	
89	For `$vars.<loopId>.currentItem` etc. to resolve, you must add corresponding entries to `variables.nodes`:
90	
91	```json
92	{
93	  "variables": {
94	    "nodes": [
95	      {
96	        "id": "loop1.currentItem",
97	        "type": "any",
98	        "description": "The current item being iterated in the loop",
99	        "binding": { "nodeId": "loop1", "outputId": "currentItem" }
100	      },
101	      {
102	        "id": "loop1.currentIndex",
103	        "type": "number",
104	        "description": "The current iteration index (0-based)",
105	        "binding": { "nodeId": "loop1", "outputId": "currentIndex" }
106	      },
107	      {
108	        "id": "loop1.collection",
109	        "type": "array",
110	        "description": "The collection being iterated over",
111	        "binding": { "nodeId": "loop1", "outputId": "collection" }
112	      },
113	      {
114	        "id": "loop1.output",
115	        "type": "array",
116	        "description": "Aggregated results from all loop iterations",
117	        "binding": { "nodeId": "loop1", "outputId": "output" }
118	      }
119	    ]
120	  }
121	}
122	```
123	
124	## State Accumulation with variableUpdates
125	
126	To accumulate state across loop iterations (counters, running totals), use an `inout` variable with a `variableUpdate` on the body node:
127	
128	```json
129	{
130	  "variables": {
131	    "globals": [
132	      {
133	        "id": "runningTotal",
134	        "direction": "inout",
135	        "type": "number",
136	        "defaultValue": 0
137	      }
138	    ],
139	    "variableUpdates": {
140	      "bodyNode": [
141	        {
142	          "variableId": "runningTotal",
143	          "expression": "=js:$vars.bodyNode.output"
144	        }
145	      ]
146	    }
147	  }
148	}
149	```
150	
151	The variableUpdate fires after each iteration, so the `inout` variable carries the accumulated value into the next iteration.
152	
153	> **Critical:** The variableUpdate expression **cannot** access loop iteration variables like `$vars.<loopId>.currentItem`. These are only available inside the body node's script. The variableUpdate must reference the body node's output (e.g., `=js:$vars.bodyNode.output`). If you need to compute using `currentItem`, do the computation in the script and reference the script's output in the variableUpdate.
154	
155	## Complete Example — Loop with State Accumulation
156	
157	A flow that iterates over a collection, accumulates a result in an `inout` variable via a Script body node, and outputs the final value.
158	
159	```json
160	{
161	  "nodes": [
162	    {
163	      "id": "start",
164	      "type": "core.trigger.manual",
165	      "typeVersion": "1.0",
166	      "display": { "label": "Manual trigger" },
167	      "inputs": { "entryPointId": "..." }
168	    },
169	    {
170	      "id": "loop1",
171	      "type": "core.logic.loop",
172	      "typeVersion": "1.0",
173	      "display": { "label": "Loop" },
174	      "inputs": { "collection": "=js:$vars.inputItems", "parallel": false }
175	    },
176	    {
177	      "id": "bodyScript",
178	      "type": "core.action.script",
179	      "typeVersion": "1.0",
180	      "display": { "label": "Process item" },
181	      "inputs": {
182	        "script": "return $vars.accumulator + $vars.loop1.currentItem;"
183	      },
184	      "parentId": "loop1"
185	    },
186	    {
187	      "id": "end1",
188	      "type": "core.control.end",
189	      "typeVersion": "1.0",
190	      "display": { "label": "End" },
191	      "inputs": {},
192	      "outputs": {
193	        "result": { "source": "=js:$vars.accumulator" }
194	      }
195	    }
196	  ],
197	  "edges": [
198	    { "id": "e1", "sourceNodeId": "start", "sourcePort": "output", "targetNodeId": "loop1", "targetPort": "input" },
199	    { "id": "e2", "sourceNodeId": "loop1", "sourcePort": "output", "targetNodeId": "bodyScript", "targetPort": "input" },
200	    { "id": "e3", "sourceNodeId": "bodyScript", "sourcePort": "success", "targetNodeId": "loop1", "targetPort": "loopBack" },
201	    { "id": "e4", "sourceNodeId": "loop1", "sourcePort": "success", "targetNodeId": "end1", "targetPort": "input" }
202	  ],
203	  "variables": {
204	    "globals": [
205	      { "id": "inputItems", "direction": "in", "type": "array", "defaultValue": [] },
206	      { "id": "accumulator", "direction": "inout", "type": "number", "defaultValue": 0 },
207	      { "id": "result", "direction": "out", "type": "number" }
208	    ],
209	    "nodes": [
210	      { "id": "loop1.currentItem", "type": "any", "binding": { "nodeId": "loop1", "outputId": "currentItem" } },
211	      { "id": "loop1.currentIndex", "type": "number", "binding": { "nodeId": "loop1", "outputId": "currentIndex" } },
212	      { "id": "loop1.collection", "type": "array", "binding": { "nodeId": "loop1", "outputId": "collection" } },
213	      { "id": "loop1.output", "type": "array", "binding": { "nodeId": "loop1", "outputId": "output" } },
214	      { "id": "bodyScript.output", "type": "object", "binding": { "nodeId": "bodyScript", "outputId": "output" } },
215	      { "id": "bodyScript.error", "type": "object", "binding": { "nodeId": "bodyScript", "outputId": "error" } }
216	    ],
217	    "variableUpdates": {
218	      "bodyScript": [
219	        { "variableId": "accumulator", "expression": "=js:$vars.bodyScript.output" }
220	      ]
221	    }
222	  }
223	}
224	```
225	
226	Key points in this pattern:
227	- `bodyScript` has `"parentId": "loop1"` — places it inside the loop
228	- Script accesses `$vars.loop1.currentItem` for the current iteration value
229	- `variableUpdate` on `bodyScript` writes the script's return value back to `accumulator`
230	- `accumulator` is `inout` so it persists across iterations
231	- End node maps the final accumulated value to the `out` variable
232	
233	## Debug
234	
235	| Error | Cause | Fix |
236	| --- | --- | --- |
237	| Collection is empty or null | Expression evaluates to null/undefined | Check `collection` expression and upstream output |
238	| `$vars.loop1.currentItem` is undefined | Missing node variable binding or missing `parentId` | Add `loop1.currentItem` to `variables.nodes` and set `parentId` on body nodes |
239	| State variable not updating across iterations | Body node missing `parentId` | Add `"parentId": "<loopId>"` to every node inside the loop body |
240	| State variable becomes `NaN` | variableUpdate expression uses `$vars.<loopId>.currentItem` | Loop variables are not available in variableUpdate expressions. Do the computation in the script and reference `$vars.<bodyNodeId>.output` in the variableUpdate |
241	| Infinite loop | Edges wired incorrectly | Ensure only `loopBack` creates the cycle, not arbitrary edges |
242	| No output after loop | Missing `success` edge | Wire the `success` port to the next downstream node |
